Name: Dessert Animals
Author: CacklingxCaracal
Description: This mod adds: Orange Creamsicle and Key Lime Cows, Hunny Bunnies, Chai spice, and Lemon Bar Rabbits, Candy apple pigs, Caramel apple pigs, a living custard, cotton candy sheep, Mallow Hens, Peanut Butter Hens, Gingerbread Goats and Banana Pudding Ostriches! There are also Gumdrop Puffers, Sour Strip Eels and a Swedish Fish available for catching. Also adds a new machine for processing items, and several new recipes you can learn.

Downloads.Description: Now includes BananaPudding Ostriches, Gingerbread Goats, 5 new fish, several new recipes (I'm probably forgetting stuff I'm sorry. Also includes several fixes.

Manifest.Name: Dessert Animals
Manifest.Description: Adds Coop and Barn animals themed after desserts as well as a few fish.
Manifest.Author: CacklingCaracal
